fields.description: The Grove model these sell prices apply to. One Enabled pricing per model; enabling a new one disables it.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Schedule to take over at Activates At; the gateway switches on its own clock and the pull prices each request at the pricing it was charged. Never enabled directly, never disabled by hand and never re-enabled: a wrong price is a new pricing plus a credit row.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: When the gateways switch to this pricing, in the site's time zone. At least the Pricing Lead in Grove Settings ahead, so it reaches every gateway first.
fields.label: Activates At

fields.description: The day it took over, stamped when it activates. Prices usage recorded before gateways tagged each request.
fields.label: Enabled On

fields.description: One row per priced counter. A counter with no row here bills 0 — sell rates come from here alone.
fields.label: Rates
